751-3755-5295.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-2841-6662-6926.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Vibrant Cityscape.
1479-2841-6662-6926.description:
Fetch a land using Vibrant Cityscape.
When the fetched land enters, Chocobo Racetrack and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Chocobo Racetrack trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Chocobo Racetrack triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1545-1981-2415-5231.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1545-1981-2415-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

2811-4399-4770-6626.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Elas il-Kor trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elas il-Kor trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
2811-4399-4770-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

2034-2178-5931-5970.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
2034-2178-5931-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Awakening Hall.
Awakening Hall triggers, returning all creature cards in your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing one of the returned creatures.
When the creature dies, Marina triggers, and Funeral Room triggers if it's unlocked.
Resolve the Marina trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, if applicable, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Awakening Hall.
Repeat steps 3 through 6 once.
Repeat from step 1.
2034-2178-5931-5970.notes: If you start the combo with Funeral Room locked, you can still unlock it with Marina if you have three or more creature cards in your graveyard. During the first loop, you'll want to repeat steps 3 through 8 one additional time, instead choosing to unlock Funeral Room. Additional Marina triggers can allow you to lock and/or unlock other Rooms as desired.

1270-3228-4478-5477.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating three 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate the Soldiers by tapping them, adding {2}{W}.

80-1618-2440-2862.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Lord of the Nazgûl
80-1618-2440-2862.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Venture Forth.
Venture Forth triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Lord of the Nazgûl triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Venture Forth.
Repeat.
80-1618-2440-2862.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Lord of the Nazgûl. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

2440-7182-7252.description:
Cast Grave Sifter for its evoke cost by paying {4}.
When Grave Sifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger, as well as Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Grave Sifter.
Resolve the Grave Sifter trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the evoke trigger, sacrificing Grave Sifter.
When Grave Sifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Grave Sifter with haste.
When the Grave Sifter token enters, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Grave Sifter token's trigger, returning Grave Sifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the Grave Sifter token.
Repeat.

2804-3490-4369-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
2804-3490-4369-5231.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Witty Roastmaster triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Witty Roastmaster triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Witty Roastmaster triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

104-4050-5086-5183-6291.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-4050-5086-5183-6291.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

2781-2921-4681.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Karmic Guide
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

4681-5147-5170-6273.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

826-2178-5231-6935.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing Otherworldly Escort to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, it and Amoeboid Changeling trigger.
Resolve the Amoeboid Changeling trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Otherworldly Escort trigger, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Spirit Detective.
Repeat.

2279-3705-5231-6896.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Squee and the creature token, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

431-2557-4365-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-2557-4365-6441.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

Gain life.

Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.

Repeat from step 2.

700-2954-6758.notablePrerequisites: Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.

Declare any creature as an attacker. Dawnsire triggers, dealing 100 damage to Body of Knowledge.

1305-5295-6575.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
As Esper Terra enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter with four lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and put up to one enchantment card milled this way into your hand.
Repeat.

Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, mutating it over or under a non-Human creature you control.

Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Astral Dragon, adding {R}.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Astral Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

4798-5435-6462.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
4798-5435-6462.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers. Holding priority, activate Dream Trawler by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Resolve the Kheru Goldkeeper trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 2.

38-2316-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
38-2316-6441.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins, creating six 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Skirk Prospector three times by sacrificing three Goblins, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1003-5147-5220-5683.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Phyrexian Walker and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Repeat.

Activate Saproling Burst by removing a fade counter from it, creating a Saproling creature token.

11-1367-5257.description:
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Riku's first ability triggers - choose not to pay.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Nexus of Fate.
Riku's first ability triggers, causing you to pay {U}{R} to copy Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Nexus of Fate, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal created in step 5, copying Nexus of Fate and returning the original Nexus of Fate to your hand.
Resolve Nexus of Fate, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
11-1367-5257.notes: You may pay an additional {U}{R} to copy the extra turn spell, and only need to do this loop during your second extra turn.

When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Workshop Assistant.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.

 Repeat.
